storeInfo.name: Diesel Lounge
storeInfo.tagline: Bold Flavors & Vibrant Nights in New Haven | Sabores Audaces y Noches Vibrantes

policies.restroomLocationEs: Ubicado hacia la parte trasera del salón principal, cerca de la barra.
policies.restroomLocationEn: Located towards the back of the main dining room near the bar.
policies.restroomCodeEn: Open for dining guests (no code required).
policies.parkingPolicyEs: Estacionamiento en la calle disponible y lotes públicos cercanos.
policies.parkingPolicyEn: Street parking available and nearby public lots.
policies.returnPolicyEs: Nos esforzamos por la satisfacción total; por favor notifique a su mesero de inmediato.
policies.returnPolicyEn: We strive for complete guest satisfaction; please notify your server immediately.
policies.deliveryPolicyEs: Servicio para llevar disponible por teléfono.

products.nameEn: Crispy chicken wings tossed in our signature house-made fiery glaze, served with cool ranch and celery sticks.
products.descriptionEs: Alitas de pollo crujientes bañadas en nuestro adobo picante de la casa, servidas con aderezo ranch y apio.
products.descriptionEn: Crispy chicken wings tossed in our signature house-made fiery glaze, served with cool ranch and celery sticks.

products.descriptionEs: Tortillas de maíz crujientes cubiertas con queso fundido, frijoles negros, jalapeños, crema agria, guacamole y pico de gallo.
products.descriptionEn: Crispy corn tortilla chips topped with melted cheese, black beans, jalapeños, sour cream, guacamole, and pico de gallo.
Mozzarella cheese breaded and fried to golden perfection, served with house-made marinara sauce.
Juicy angus beef patty with melted cheddar cheese, crispy bacon, caramelized onions, and special sauce on a brioche bun.

products.nameEs: Sándwich de Pollo a la Parrilla
products.descriptionEn: Marinated grilled chicken breast topped with fresh avocado, lettuce, tomato, and chipotle mayonnaise.
Three crispy battered fish tacos topped with purple cabbage, cilantro, and creamy ají amarillo sauce on corn tortillas.
Tender skirt steak grilled over charcoal, served with rustic rosemary potatoes and house Argentine chimichurri.
Tender pork ribs slow-smoked for hours with sweet and smoky barbecue sauce, served with French fries and coleslaw.
Fresh fettuccine tossed with jumbo shrimp in a rich garlic, white wine, and parmesan cheese cream sauce.
Tropical blend of dark and light rums, exotic fruit juices, and a splash of grenadine.

products.nameEs: Limonada casera de Fresa y Menta
products.descriptionEn: Freshly squeezed natural lemonade infused with fresh strawberry puree and mint leaves.
Draft IPA brewed locally in Connecticut featuring bright citrus and floral notes.

products.descriptionEs: Tres empanadas crujientes rellenas de carne sazonada, servidas con nuestra salsa chimichurri casera.
products.descriptionEn: Three crispy golden pastries filled with seasoned beef, served with our signature house-made chimichurri sauce.

products.descriptionEs: Pescado blanco marinado en jugo de lima fresco, cilantro, cebolla roja y un toque de ají amarillo.
products.descriptionEn: White fish marinated in fresh lime juice, cilantro, red onion, and a hint of yellow chili pepper.

products.descriptionEs: Bastones de yuca fritos hasta quedar dorados, acompañados de nuestra salsa de ajo y cítricos.
products.descriptionEn: Golden fried yuca sticks served with our zesty garlic and citrus mojo sauce.

products.descriptionEs: Anillos de calamar ligeramente empanizados y fritos, servidos con salsa marinara picante.
products.descriptionEn: Lightly breaded and fried calamari rings, served with a side of spicy marinara sauce.

products.descriptionEs: Plátanos verdes fritos y aplastados servidos con nuestro guacamole fresco de la casa.
products.descriptionEn: Twice-fried green plantains served with our fresh house-made guacamole.

products.descriptionEs: Pechuga de pollo salteada en una salsa cremosa de ajo, vino blanco y perejil, servida con arroz.
products.descriptionEn: Chicken breast sautéed in a creamy garlic, white wine, and parsley sauce, served with rice.

products.nameEs: Salmón a la Parrilla con Vegetales
products.descriptionEs: Filete de salmón fresco a la parrilla con hierbas, servido con vegetales de temporada.
products.descriptionEn: Fresh grilled salmon fillet seasoned with herbs, served with seasonal roasted vegetables.

products.descriptionEs: Pasta fresca con vegetales de temporada salteados en nuestra salsa pesto de albahaca y nueces.
products.descriptionEn: Fresh pasta tossed with seasonal vegetables in our house-made basil and walnut pesto sauce.

products.descriptionEs: Tiras de res salteadas con cebolla, tomate y ají, servidas sobre papas fritas y arroz.
products.descriptionEn: Strips of beef stir-fried with onions, tomatoes, and chili, served over fries and rice.

products.descriptionEs: Hamburguesa a base de plantas con aguacate, lechuga, tomate y cebolla en pan artesanal.
products.descriptionEn: Plant-based patty topped with avocado, lettuce, tomato, and onion on a toasted artisan bun.

products.descriptionEs: Arroz azafranado cocinado a fuego lento con una mezcla de mariscos frescos y especias.
products.descriptionEn: Saffron-infused rice slow-cooked with a medley of fresh seafood and aromatic spices.

products.descriptionEs: Carne deshebrada cocinada lentamente en salsa de tomate, pimientos y especias cubanas.
products.descriptionEn: Slow-cooked shredded beef in a rich tomato, pepper, and Cuban spice sauce.

products.descriptionEs: Chuletas de cerdo jugosas glaseadas con una reducción agridulce de tamarindo.
products.descriptionEn: Juicy pork chops glazed with a sweet and tangy tamarind reduction.

products.descriptionEs: Plato tradicional con frijoles, arroz, carne molida, chicharrón, huevo, aguacate y arepa.
products.descriptionEn: Traditional platter with beans, rice, ground beef, pork belly, egg, avocado, and arepa.

products.descriptionEs: Plátano frito machacado con ajo y chicharrón, servido con camarones en salsa criolla.
products.descriptionEn: Mashed fried plantains with garlic and pork cracklings, topped with shrimp in creole sauce.

products.descriptionEs: Tequila premium, puré de maracuyá fresco, lima y un toque de sal en el borde.
products.descriptionEn: Premium tequila, fresh passion fruit puree, lime, and a salted rim.

products.descriptionEs: Ron blanco, menta fresca, azúcar de caña, lima y soda con hielo picado.
products.descriptionEn: White rum, fresh mint, cane sugar, lime, and soda water over crushed ice.

products.descriptionEs: Café espresso fuerte y dulce, preparado al estilo tradicional cubano.
products.descriptionEn: Strong and sweet espresso coffee, prepared in the traditional Cuban style.

products.descriptionEs: Bebida refrescante de almendras, canela y vainilla servida con mucho hielo.
products.descriptionEn: Refreshing almond-based drink with cinnamon and vanilla, served over ice.

products.descriptionEs: Vino tinto mezclado con frutas frescas, brandy y un toque de soda.
products.descriptionEn: Red wine blended with fresh seasonal fruits, brandy, and a splash of soda.

faqs.qEn: Do you offer vegetarian or gluten-free options?
faqs.aEs: Sí, tenemos varias opciones claramente marcadas en nuestro menú o puede consultar con su mesero.
faqs.aEn: Yes, we offer several options clearly marked on our menu or you can ask your server.

faqs.qEn: Do you accept reservations for large groups?
faqs.aEs: Aceptamos reservaciones y también recibimos clientes sin reservación según disponibilidad.
faqs.aEn: We accept reservations and also welcome walk-ins based on availability.
